# AI 获客 (AI Customer Acquisition)

> An open-source, continuously updated book on customer acquisition in the age of AI search and agents: GEO / answer engines, buyer agents and platform dependency.
> 一本免费公开、持续更新的开源书：客户在问 AI，你在答案里吗——AI 搜索、Agent 采购、平台推荐与依赖对冲。

Key thesis: 客户现在不只在搜索框和展会上挑供应商了——他们开始问 AI、让 Agent 去筛、看平台推的和别人说的。本书讲的是在这几个新地方，还有那些老地方，怎么把客户拿到手。
(Acquisition now happens where the buyer asks an AI, hands selection to an agent, or trusts a platform's push — not only in a search box or a trade show.)

## Links

- Read online (Chinese): https://ai-customer-acquisition.fly2ai.top
- GitHub: https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book
- PDF (latest): https://github.com/Jweokk/ai-customer-acquisition-book/raw/main/book/ai-customer-acquisition.pdf

## Source discipline 来源纪律

每条数据标注性质：【官方口径】/【第三方验证】/【厂商宣称】/【本书判断】/【本书实测】。核不到原始发布方的数字不写入正文。自建实测公开方法与原始数据。
